name: sumsec-skills
description: SummerSec personal Agent Skills marketplace. Plugins: writing-zh, media-tools, dev-tools, agents-dev. Install what you need.

plugins.name: writing-zh
plugins.description: Chinese writing tools: humanizer-zh (de-AIify text), creating-blog-web-ppt (Markdown to HTML slides), and khazix-writer (personal voice long-form writing).

plugins.name: media-tools
plugins.description: Media generation: draw-image-generation (AI images via Right.Codes API) and remotion-best-practices (React video).

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Developer tools: git-commit-pr (commit & PR), agent-chat-history (browse agent logs), context7-cli/mcp/find-docs (library doc lookup).

plugins.name: agents-dev
plugins.description: Agent development ecosystem: skill-creator, plugin-dev (7 skills), hookify, claude-md-management, agent-sdk-dev, and multi-platform-plugin-guide.
